I set up 1 chip of WS281B-8 LEDs. Using the FastLED library, I was able to have them display a looping rainbow.

I also integrated Platformio, GitHub, and Hackatime to my VSCode workspace to be able to code fast and keep track of my work.

### 2026-10-03 – I finished soldering the LED chips and hot glued them to a piece of cardboard. Then, I ran a few test to make sure all of the LEDs light up and they did!

**2h**

I finished soldering the LED chips and hot glued them to a piece of cardboard. Then, I ran a few test to make sure all of the LEDs light up and they did!

Then, I started working on coding an Arduino Nano to be able to program each individual light. I started by creating an array of 1s and 0s. I then looped through and set each of the 40 leds to either red or blank.

Once I successfully displayed a heart shape, I created 28 more frame arrays to be able to animate a name sliding across the screen.
